104
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday, March 23, 2018/Chaitra 2, 1940 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Agriculture and Farmers Welfare; Chemicals and Fertilizers;
Coal; Communications; Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution;
Electronics and Information Technology; Food Processing Industries;
Law and Justice; Parliamentary Affairs; Railways)
Total number of questions — 15
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Website for reporting lapses in safety
operations
*301. SHRI A. K. SELV ARAJ: Will
the Minister of  RAILWAYS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Railways
have launched a website where its 13 lakh
employees can report internal lapses in
safety operations and hazards without
disclosing their identity;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the total number of such lapses
concerning security reported on the said
website and the action taken thereon?
Safety of labourers engaged by
BSNL
†*302. SHRI R. K. SINHA: Will the
Minister of  COMMUNICATIONS be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of permanent,
temporary and contractual labourers
engaged by Bharat Sanchar Nigam Limited
(BSNL) for laying of cables and repairing
cable joints; and
(b) whether the personal safety
equipments are being provided to these
labourers engaged in such hazardous works
so that their hands and fingers could be
protected from becoming useless on getting
burnt due to acid leakage?
Aquaculture and Animal Husbandry
Infrastructure Development Funds
*303. SHRI K. K. RAGESH: Will the
Minister of  AGRICULTURE AND
FARMERS WELFARE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the Fisheries and
Aquaculture Infrastructure Development
Fund and an Animal Husbandry
Infrastructure Development Fund are being
established;
(b) the total corpus fund proposed for
each of the above Funds; and

105
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(c) whether any allocation has been
made for the above Funds, so far, or any
specific proposals are there with
Government to build up the corpus?
Railway works in partnership with
private sector
†*304. SHRI VISHAMBHAR
PRASAD NISHAD: Will the Minister of
RAILW AYS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Railways
are considering to get a number of works
done in partnership with private sector,
including the accident insurance scheme;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the amount received, so far, from
the railway passengers for accident
insurance under online railway accident
insurance scheme;
(d) the total amount disbursed to the
passengers as accident compensation;
(e) the amount received by Railways
under this head; and
(f) whether it is also a fact that the
private sector is earning huge profit from
the works being carried out for Railways?
Subsidy for horticulture and cash
crops
*305. SHRI RAMKUMAR VERMA:
Will the Minister of  AGRICULTURE
AND FARMERS WELFARE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
horticulture crops like orange, kinnu and
cash crops like jeera, isabgol, etc., have
higher preliminary expenditure (approx.
` 1 lakh per hectare) but as per the State
Disaster Response Fund (SDRF) norms,
the Agriculture Input Subsidy for such
crop damages is only ` 18,000/- per
hectare;
(b) whether Government intends to
increase Agriculture Input Subsidy up to
atleast ` 50,000/- per hectare for
horticulture crops and cash crops due to
high initial cost in the entire State of
Rajasthan;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Contribution of women in
agriculture
*306. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of  AGRICULTURE
AND FARMERS WELFARE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government has conducted
any survey or undertaken any study on
participation of women and their
contribution to agriculture in Maharashtra
and rest of the country;
(b) if  so, the details thereof and
outcome of the survey or study in this
regard; and
(c) the welfare measures extended or
proposed to be extended by Government
to the women farmers of  Maharashtra
and rest of the country?
Promotion of FPIs in Himachal Pradesh
*307. SHRIMATI VIPLOVE
THAKUR: Will the Minister of  FOOD
PROCESSING  INDUSTRIES  be pleased
to state:
(a) the number of food processing units/
industries registered and functioning in the
country along with the products which
are being processed therein, State-wise,
including Himachal Pradesh;

106
(b) whether there has been a shortage
of food processing units, resulting in
farmers not getting fair price of their
produces in Himachal Pradesh;
(c) whether Government proposes to
set up more food processing units/
industries or revive closed food processing
units/industries in Himachal Pradesh; and
(d) if so, the details thereof, unit/
industry-wise?
Assessment of manpower in the
Ministry
*308. DR. VINAY P.
SAHASRABUDDHE: Will the Minister
of  AGRICULTURE AND FARMERS
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Ministry as a whole,
together with all its Departments and also

Electronics and Information Technology; Food Processing Industries;
Law and Justice; Parliamentary Affairs; Railways)
Total number of questions — 160
NDDB grant to various organisations
3201. SHRI HARIV ANSH: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE AND
FARMERS WELFARE be pleased to
state:
(a) the total amount of grants given by
National Dairy Development Board
(NDDB) during 2004-14 to various
organisations other than cooperatives for
various activities including studies
subventions etc.;
(b) the names of these institutions and
the amount of grant given to them;
(c) the names of the Chairman/MD/
Secretary of these organisations during the
period when the grants were given;
(d) whether any of the senior officers
of NDDB were office bearers in these
organisations during that period; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Production of Kharif crops
3202. SHRI MAJEED MEMON: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE AND
FARMERS WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the country's
Kharif foodgrain production is estimated
to decline by 2.78 per cent to 134.67 million
tonnes,  if so, the details thereof;
(b) the details of Kharif production
during the last five years; and
(c) whether the pulses output may drop
to 8.71 million tonnes from the record 9.42
million tonnes, if so, the steps taken by
Government to curb any possible price rise
in future?
Reduced budgetary outlay to Price
Stabilization Fund
3203. SHRI VIVEK GUPTA: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE AND
FARMERS WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) the reasons for more than 78 per

753
cent reduction in the outlay to Price
Stabilization Fund, from ` 6900 crore in
2016-17 to `1500 crore in 2018-19;
(b) the reasons for fall in allocation for
Market Intervention Scheme—Price
Support Scheme (MIS-PSS) from `950
crore in 2017-18 to `200 crore in 2018-19;
(c) the details of price stabilization
activities undertaken by Government to
stabilize prices of farm output during last
four years, crop-wise and State-wise; and
(d) the details of farm output, where its
market price is less than the MSP during
the last four years, crop-wise and State-
wise?
Market regulation for seafood
3204. SHRI CHUNIBHAI
KANJIBHAI GOHEL: Will the Minister
of AGRICULTURE AND FARMERS
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) the action taken by the Ministry to
extend MIP/MIS schemes for domestically
produced fisheries/seafood items, as due
to lack of domestic market regulation for
seafood, fishermen are facing great
difficulties and sometimes they are not able
to recover their production cost; and
(b) whether the Ministry is going to
approach/communicate with State
Governments for market regulation of
domestically produced seafood/fisheries
items, if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Agriculture courses in engineering
colleges
3205. MAHANT
SHAMBHUPRASADJI TUNDIYA: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE AND
FARMERS WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has allowed
Gujarat Technology Affiliated Engineering
Colleges to start the agriculture courses
without ICAR permission;
(b) whether there in any rule that private
universities can start the agriculture courses
in Gujarat and in the country; and
(c) if so, the details of the said rule?
Fall in prices of farm produces
3206. DR. PRABHAKAR KORE: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE AND
FARMERS WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
proposes to increase the import duty on
farm produces to the maximum allowed
limit, to control the falling prices of farm
produces due to the cheap imports;
(b) if so, the details of the proposal and
time-frame for its implementation; and
(c) the details of other steps taken by
Government to check falling prices of farm
produces?
Production of pulses
3207. SHRI PARIMAL NATHWANI:
Will the Minister of  AGRICULTURE
AND FARMERS WELFARE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the production of pulses in
the country has been affected due to
drought during the last three consecutive
years, if so, the details thereof, State-wise;
(b) the steps taken by Government to
increase the production of pulses;
(c) the names of States where the
National Food Security Mission is being
implemented; and
(d) the allocation made for increasing
pulses production during the Financial Year
2018-19?

754
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
MSP for crops of next Kharif season
3208. SHRI K.K. RAGESH: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE AND
FARMERS WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether any concrete proposal is
there to raise the funds needed to guarantee
MSP to farmers at 1.5 times of the cost of
production from the next Kharif season;
and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
